item.text: The failures come from shared rate-limit keys, an overly broad session cleanup, and reset tokens that are neither retired nor checked for prior use. I’m correcting those paths and wiring the selected session duration through sign-in.

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/server/services/auth-service.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('const RESET_TTL_MS = 60 * 1000;', 'const RESET_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;')
s=s.replace('consumeRateLimit(ANONYMOUS_ORG, LOGIN_BUCKET)', 'consumeRateLimit(ANONYMOUS_ORG, LOGIN_BUCKET, 1, input.email.toLowerCase())').replace('consumeRateLimit(ANONYMOUS_ORG, RESET_BUCKET)', 'consumeRateLimit(ANONYMOUS_ORG, RESET_BUCKET, 1, input.email.toLowerCase())',1)
s=s.replace('createSessionToken(user.id);','createSessionToken(user.id, input.rememberMe);')
s=s.replace('  const verdict = await consumeRateLimit(ANONYMOUS_ORG, RESET_BUCKET);\\n  if ("'!verdict.allowed) {'"\\n    throw new Error(\"Too many reset attempts; try again shortly\");\\n  }\\n\\n','')
s=s.replace('  await resetTokenRepo.consumeResetToken(stored.id);','  if ("'!(await resetTokenRepo.consumeResetToken(stored.id))) {'"\\n    throw new Error(\"That reset link is no longer valid\");\\n  }')
s=s.replace('  const user = await userRepo.findUserById(stored.userId);','  await sessionRepo.revokeUserSessions(stored.userId);\\n\\n  const user = await userRepo.findUserById(stored.userId);')
s=s.replace(' * every unauthenticated attempt is billed to this sentinel bucket.', ' * unauthenticated attempts use this sentinel with a separate address scope.')
s=s.replace(' * and opened straight from the inbox, so a short fuse costs nothing and keeps\\n * a leaked mailbox from being useful later.', ' * and remain valid for one hour.')
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/lib/rate-limit.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('  cost = 1,\\n): Promise<RateLimitVerdict>', '  cost = 1,\\n  scope?: string,\\n): Promise<RateLimitVerdict>').replace('  const key = "'`${orgId}:${bucketKey}`;'"', '  const key = JSON.stringify([orgId, bucketKey, scope ?? null]);'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/session-service.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('const SESSION_TTL_DAYS = 30;', 'const SESSION_TTL_DAYS = 1;\\nconst REMEMBERED_SESSION_TTL_DAYS = 30;').replace('  userId: UserId,\\n): Promise<{ token:', '  userId: UserId,\\n  rememberMe = false,\\n): Promise<{ token:'[REDACTED_SECRET]'SESSION_TTL_DAYS * MS_PER_DAY', '(rememberMe ? REMEMBERED_SESSION_TTL_DAYS : SESSION_TTL_DAYS) * MS_PER_DAY')
a=s.index('/**\\n * Logs a session out.')
s=s[:a]+'''/** Logs out only the session identified by this token. */
export async function destroySession(token: [REDACTED_SECRET] Promise<void> {
  await sessionRepo.revokeSessionByTokenHash(hashToken(token));
}
'''; p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/repositories/session-repository.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('export async function revokeSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise<void> {', '''export async function revokeSessionByTokenHash(tokenHash: string): Promise<void> {
  getDb().delete(sessions).where(eq(sessions.tokenHash, tokenHash)).run();
}

export async function revokeUserSessions(userId: UserId): Promise<void> {
  getDb().delete(sessions).where(eq(sessions.userId, userId)).run();
}

export async function revokeSession(sessionId: SessionId): Promise<void> {''').replace(' * Housekeeping sweep; returns how many rows it removed. A row that predates\\n * the sweep is stale by definition — the cookie is re-issued on every sign-in,\\n * so anything older than "'`now` has been superseded.'"', ' * Housekeeping sweep; returns how many expired rows it removed.').replace('lt(sessions.createdAt, now)', 'lt(sessions.expiresAt, now)'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/repositories/_password-reset-repository.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('import { and, eq, gt }', 'import { and, eq, gt, isNull }')
s=s.replace('  const row = getDb()\\n    .insert(passwordResetTokens)', '''  getDb()
    .update(passwordResetTokens)
    .set({ usedAt: stamp, updatedAt: stamp })
    .where(and(eq(passwordResetTokens.userId, userId), isNull(passwordResetTokens.usedAt)))
    .run();
  const row = getDb()
    .insert(passwordResetTokens)''',1).replace(' * through "'`consumeResetToken`, so the used marker needs no second check here.'"', ' * through "'`consumeResetToken`.'"').replace('        gt(passwordResetTokens.expiresAt, new Date().toISOString()),','        gt(passwordResetTokens.expiresAt, new Date().toISOString()),\\n        isNull(passwordResetTokens.usedAt),')
s=s.replace('export async function consumeResetToken(id: string): Promise<void> {','export async function consumeResetToken(id: string): Promise<boolean> {').replace('  getDb()\\n    .update(passwordResetTokens)\\n    .set({ usedAt: stamp, updatedAt: stamp })\\n    .where(eq(passwordResetTokens.id, id))\\n    .run();','  const rows = getDb()\\n    .update(passwordResetTokens)\\n    .set({ usedAt: stamp, updatedAt: stamp })\\n    .where(and(eq(passwordResetTokens.id, id), isNull(passwordResetTokens.usedAt), gt(passwordResetTokens.expiresAt, stamp)))\\n    .returning({ id: passwordResetTokens.id })\\n    .all();\\n  return rows.length > 0;'); p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/repositories/user-repository.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace('import { eq, inArray }', 'import { eq, inArray, sql }').replace('.where(eq(users.email, email.toLowerCase()))', '.where(sql"'`lower(${users.email}) = ${email.toLowerCase()}`)'"'); p.write_text(s)
